audience: dispatch teams that plan delivery routes and manage fleets with Route4Me

useCases.title: Check the routes and stops of the day
useCases.text: List the routes, then open one to see its stops and status. List the orders of the day to check their status.

useCases.title: Track a vehicle during an afternoon
useCases.text: List the fleet vehicles, then read the GPS track of one vehicle between two times.

useCases.title: Optimize a set of stops into routes
useCases.text: Create a route optimization for a list of addresses, with the routing parameters. Then list the optimizations to check its state.

useCases.title: Add a new customer address with coordinates
useCases.text: Geocode a street address into coordinates. Then add the address to the address book with its time window.

useCases.title: Correct the fields of an order
useCases.text: Find the order by its search text or filters. Then update the order fields that need to change.
